title: AI Lead Automation for Real Estate Agents & Teams

blocks.heading: Speed-to-Lead in *60 Seconds*
blocks.lead: Every portal lead answered in under a minute, qualified by AI, and booked to a showing — even at midnight. Your old database gets nurtured on autopilot while you close.

items.title: The lead came in at 11pm.
items.body: By the time you saw it in the morning, they'd already booked a showing with someone else.

items.title: My CRM has 2,000 dead leads.
items.body: They're not dead — just neglected. Nobody's followed up since the first call that never happened.

items.title: Follow-up dies after one attempt.
items.body: You meant to call back. You were at a showing. The trail went cold.

items.title: I chase new leads while old ones cool.
items.body: You keep paying for fresh portals while the database you already own sits there, gathering dust.

header.title: Your 24/7 *inside sales agent*
header.subtitle: Connects to your existing CRM — Follow Up Boss, kvCORE, Sierra, or whatever you run. No platform switch.

items.title: Instant Response
items.body: Every new lead gets a personal-feeling text or call within 60 seconds — from the portals, your site, and your sign riders. Day, night, weekends.

items.title: AI Qualification
items.body: The AI works the conversation: budget, timeline, pre-approval, motivation. Hot leads land on your calendar; cold ones get nurtured, not dropped.

items.title: Booking + Nurture
items.body: Showings booked straight to your calendar. Your old database gets revived with long-term nurture sequences that turn "not now" into "ready."

blocks.math: 4 extra showings/month × 15% close rate × $9,000 avg commission = *~$5,400/month in additional GCI*
blocks.assumptions: Assumptions: fast, persistent follow-up converts 4 more leads per month into showings; 15% of showings close; $9,000 average commission per closing. Your numbers will differ — the free audit maps your actual lead flow.
blocks.disclaimer: Illustrative estimate for example purposes only. Actual results vary by market, price point, and lead volume.

items.title: USA-Based Team
items.body: Real humans, real support, your timezone.

items.title: Works With Your CRM
items.body: Follow Up Boss, kvCORE, Sierra, and more.

items.title: Live in 1–2 Weeks
items.body: Connected to your lead sources and calendar.

items.title: SMB-Friendly Pricing
items.body: Built for solo agents and teams, not brokerages-with-a-vendor-department.

items.title: No Long-Term Contracts
items.body: Month-to-month, cancel with 14 days' notice. If the leads don't convert, walk away.

header.title: See exactly where *leads are leaking*
header.subtitle: A 30-minute working session — not a sales pitch. You leave with a fixed-quote plan whether or not you hire us.

items.title: Lead Flow Map
items.body: We trace every lead source, your actual response time, and where follow-up dies — and put a dollar figure on it.

items.title: Fixed-Quote Plan
items.body: You get an exact scope, timeline, and price for the speed-to-lead and nurture system that fits your pipeline. No hourly billing.

items.title: Zero Commitment
items.body: Keep the plan and implement it yourself, or hand it to us. The audit is free either way.

items.a: It depends on scope — a solo agent's setup versus a full team with ISA replacement and database revival. The free audit gives you a fixed quote before you spend anything.

items.q: Do I need a new CRM?
items.a: No. We connect to the CRM you already use. If you're running on spreadsheets, we'll help you graduate to a proper one as part of the build.

items.q: How fast can this be live?
items.a: Most systems are up and running in 1–2 weeks, including testing against your actual lead sources.
You never touch code. Once it's live, responses, qualification, and nurture run themselves — you just take the appointments that show up on your calendar.

blocks.heading: Never lose a lead *to voicemail again.*
blocks.body: The first agent to respond usually wins. Get your free audit and make sure that's you.

seo.metaDescription: Every portal lead answered in under 60 seconds, qualified by AI, booked to a showing. Free automation audit for realtors and real estate teams.
